summary: Tested AI Receptionist (separate web page, hours/after-hours, messages inbox, inbound call summaries) and the admin Bird balance estimate, through the API (13/13 pytest pass) and the UI with Playwright. All requested flows work. Found 1 minor functional bug (the Messages tab count pill does not update after Mark done) and a few UX/copy issues. I did not click 'I topped up Bird' because it resets the shared estimate; the invalid-amount path was checked through the API.

minor.issue: cleanAgent rebuilds role and hours from the body. A PUT without role/hours (old client, API user, or a future bot path that doesn't spread the agent) silently resets role to 'agent' and hours to null. The web form and bot-receptionist.js send the full agent today, so this is a latent risk only.
setHandled matches any aiCalls id of the account, including outbound or test calls that are not messages, and returns 200. Should add MSG_Q to the filter so non-message ids return 404.

aiMessage is grouped under the 'voicemail' preference. Turning off 'New voicemail alerts' also stops AI receptionist message emails, and the email footer says 'Stop voicemail alerts'. Consider a separate preference or clearer copy.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Mark done' the To do filter shows (0), but the Messages tab pill rec-tab-messages-count still shows 1 until the page reloads. The page-level useApi('/ai-receptionist/messages?open=1&limit=1') is not reloaded or updated after mark/reopen.

issues: The OpeningPreview still shows 'WHEN IT CALLS A LEAD (SAMPLE NAME "ALEX")' with an outbound line. In receptionist mode it should show only the inbound 'when it answers your number' line.
Copy still says agent: the button reads 'Save agent', the toast says 'Agent saved', and delete asks 'Delete this agent?'. Use 'receptionist' in mode='receptionist'.

The list still shows the 'Front Desk' receptionist (role=receptionist) as a calling agent. Consider filtering out role=receptionist, or adding a 'Receptionist' tag or link, so the two features feel separate.
The amount input admin-bird-topup-amount stretches the full card width even though it has w-28 (civr-input width wins), and it has no '$' prefix or label. The button wraps below it.

action_items: Reload or refresh the tab-level open count (msgs) in Receptionist.js after mark/reopen in Messages (e.g. pass an onChange callback, or use the 'open' value returned by the PUT).
Receptionist mode: hide the outbound opening preview and rename 'Save agent'/'Agent saved'/'Delete this agent' to receptionist wording.
Restrict setHandled to message-type inbound calls (MSG_Q) so other call ids return 404.
Optional: keep role/hours on PUT when they are missing from the body (merge with the existing agent).
Optional: give aiMessage emails their own preference, or rename the voicemail toggle and footer copy.
Optional: fix the Bird top-up amount input width and add a $ label.
critical_code_review_comments: store.cleanAgent: role/hours are not partial-update safe (see backend minor).
bot-receptionist.js setAfter spreads a.hours. If hours is null, validateHours gets an object without timezone/days. Make sure this button only shows when hours exist (static review only).

bird-spend.check() and birdExtras need BIRD_API_KEY, so the 80% alert never fires when the key is missing (expected). The flush() catch re-adds pending, but the 5s timer is not re-armed after a failed flush, so the retry only happens on the next add().

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all requested flows pass; 1 stale count pill)
